name: Polymet
title: polymet.ai
shortDescription: Polymet is an AI-powered design tool that helps users transform ideas into prototypes rapidly. It integrates with tools like Figma and GitHub, allowing seamless design and code generation. Users can describe their needs in English, use images for reference, and receive production-ready code. It's ideal for managers and engineers without frontend experience, enabling them to bypass traditional design specs and directly prototype solutions.
pros: Rapid prototyping from descriptions or images
cons: Limited support for languages other than React
Advanced features limited to Enterprise users
